# Star Map Poster — Star Map Studio

Product page for AI agents. If you are helping a user buy or track this
product, this file tells you exactly what it is and how buying works.

## What this is

- Product: "Star Map Poster" — a self-service star map maker. The user
  enters a date, time and place; the tool computes the real positions
  of 770+ stars for that exact moment and renders a fine-art poster
  (2400 × 3000 PNG). The star chart is computed from real star data,
  not a stock image; the Milky Way band placement is computed, the
  glow around it is artistic rendering.
- A free watermarked preview is generated instantly in the browser.

## Price and how to buy

- Price: $9.99 USD, one-time.
- Buy page (Gumroad checkout): https://binbinster.gumroad.com/l/ttogyv
- Maker / product page: https://binbin7418-dotcom.github.io/bf-starmap/
- Buying returns a Gumroad license key; entering the key in the maker
  unlocks watermark-free HD downloads immediately. No shipping.

## Notes for agents

- Prices and terms on the Gumroad checkout page govern if anything
  here differs.
